name: dsh-cockpit
description: DSH 驾驶舱套件：模块化的自动续轮（全模型失败兜底 + 中文内联提示 + 设置页）、会话归档与空对话清理、下载进度、删除审计和孤儿附件清理（推理强度滑条由独立的 dsh-effort-slider 提供）。 · Suite with provider-independent auto-continue, session-archive and empty-session management, download progress, deletion audit and orphan-attachment cleanup; the reasoning slider lives in the standalone dsh-effort-slider package.

scripts.check: node scripts/build-client.mjs --check && node --check host.js && node --check client.js
scripts.test: node verify-cockpit.cjs && node verify-archive.cjs && node verify-auto-continue.cjs && node verify-client-ui.cjs && node verify-downloads.cjs && node verify-maintenance.cjs

author: June M
